Hi all,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great alignment on scope. Attached is MAP draft v2 (spreadsheet) and a SOW stub. I pulled the milestones we discussed and sketched an initial RACI based on who was on the call. Please review and indicate any changes by EOD tomorrow so we can lock the timeline.

Proposed milestones (high level):
- M1 Kickoff + requirements walkthrough: target 2026-03-25 (Redwood + OrbitPay)
- M2 Security & compliance sign-off (network config, SOC2 evidence): target 2026-04-08
- M3 POC infra provisioned and smoke tests: target 2026-04-22
- M4 Legal SOW final / procurement issuing PO: target 2026-05-05
- M5 Pilot go-live (limited production): target 2026-05-12

Initial RACI (please confirm):
- Economic buyer (A): Carla Mendoza (OrbitPay) — accountable for budget/contract
- Security owner (C/A): Rajiv Singh (OrbitPay) — consulted for controls; Neha Kapoor (Redwood) is Redwood's security lead (responsible for providing evidence)
- Legal owner (C): Elena Torres (OrbitPay) and Rachel Kim (Redwood Legal) — track redlines
- Engineering lead (R): Tom Wu (OrbitPay) and Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — responsible for POC work and integration

Dependencies we flagged: SOC 2 artifacts, network peering details, sample dataset for verification, and procurement timeline.

Attachments: [Attachment: 2026-03-18_MAP_draft_v2.xlsx (Excel)] [Attachment: SOW-orbitpay-draft.pdf (PDF)]
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/OP-4521

Thanks,

Quick technical note after reading the MAP: two infra items we should account for that affect the POC provisioning date.

1) Network peering + firewall rules: OrbitPay needs to provide CIDR ranges and any egress restrictions. Setup + validation usually takes 3 business days after we receive info.
2) Test dataset delivery: we need a representative (anonymized) sample to validate tokenization & privacy checks — ideally by 2026-04-08 so we can run full smoke tests.

Given those, I'm suggesting we push "POC infra provisioned" from 2026-04-22 to 2026-04-26 to allow for security scanning and a small buffer. If OrbitPay can provide CIDRs and a point of contact for VPN configuration by 2026-03-24, we should be fine.

I'll pick up provisioning tasks on the Redwood side and coordinate with Neha for validation windows.

- Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Platform Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
